title: pm-dispatch(reading-discipline follow-up): claims keep their in-seat full read; os-dev.md stops pointing a thread into SKILL.md; home the "agents type not loaded in a thread" reading
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cwTZvo7tAGwbbRW2b8

Filing gate: ③ 维护者直派. The maintainer told this seat to file the supplementary cards its review judged necessary for the token-saving work (Elon, project thread, 2026-11-12 21:54:51Z, verbatim: 「…按照你的意见补充立卡并全部交给 skills 车道 派发。都是 p1」). This card carries the three should-fix findings of the contract review of PR #32866 (card #32855, comment 6837611936) that the PR does not fix, so the PR lands without moving its head. Priority p2: none of the three changes a gate or loses a rule today; each closes a gap a reader could fall into.

**Business reason.** #32855 tells a card thread not to read `SKILL.md`, to save resident context. Three loose ends can undo or misdirect that: a claim read could be outsourced by a misreading, the dev agent's own file still sends a thread into `SKILL.md`, and the measured reason a thread reads `os-dev.md` at all is now written nowhere, so a later cut could delete it. Reader who acts: the `domain:skills` seat (os-dev on `.claude/**`; contract-tier review). Lands after PR #32866.

Blocked-by: #32855

## Part 1 — `reading-discipline.md:35` clause order (review ④-a)
On #32866's head the line reads 「…⛔ 不只读尾;认领与契约复审仍整读卡/PR 线程,长线程照 runbook 外包。」 The nearest reading joins the carve-out and the outsourcing: "a claim reads the whole thread, and when long, outsources it". `dispatch-runbook.md:60` forbids outsourcing a ruling-grade read but does not name a claim; `execution-duties.md:11` keeps the claim read in the seat. Reorder in place, same bytes: 「…⛔ 不只读尾;长线程照 runbook 外包;认领与契约复审仍整读卡/PR 线程。」

## Part 2 — `os-dev.md` pointers into `SKILL.md` (review ④-b)
`.claude/agents/os-dev.md:56` 「收口卡定义住 pm-dispatch 报告契约」 points at `SKILL.md` (§报告契约), which a thread is now told ⛔ not to read; retarget it to the definition a thread may read (the review names `triage-duties.md:74`; confirm on `origin/main`) or state the definition in place. `:356` 「框架唯一副本在 pm-dispatch SKILL.md 〈升级与决策〉」 already says the order pastes the frame verbatim; leave it unless it reads as an order to open `SKILL.md`. Nit, same class, judge and say which way: each reference's header line 「见 SKILL.md 的对应各节」.

## Part 3 — home the dropped reading (review ④-c)
#32866 cut 「仓 `.claude/agents` 类型未加载(实测)」 from `dispatch-runbook.md:143` for budget. It is why a thread reads `os-dev.md` by hand. Record it as a fact row in `platform-readings.md` (a measured increment; the file's ceiling rule is in `triage-duties.md`), with its measurement source if one can be found in the history of `dispatch-runbook.md:143` (`node scripts/pm/git-history.mjs touch --path=.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md`).

## Acceptance
- The three parts in the tree; `node scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`, `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` green; in-place or same-file-paid edits only where a file is at its ceiling, ⛔ no re-wrap.
- skip-changeset. Clause-②: no · Metadata-protocol: none.

Dedupe (open AND closed): `is:issue "os-dev.md" SKILL.md pointer in:body created:>2026-11-01` → 2 hits, #31050 (closed, issue_patch door) and #32847 (closed, superseded by #32855 and siblings); neither covers these. **New.**
